history_policy: Existing diagrams and failed checkpoints were preserved.
steps: hybrid local index routes to five conversations
short conversations remain whole and long conversations contribute complete turns
owner permission boundary before remote transfer
Qwen3-Reranker-4B marks whole candidates TAKE, NOT_SURE or DROP
Qwen3-8B extracts small claims and line handles one message at a time
ordinary local code restores exact source lines and rejects invented handles
local DeBERTa checks whether each claim follows from its exact evidence
local secret scan blocks evidence containing detected credentials
Qwen checks whether grounded claims answer or contribute to the question
bidirectional DeBERTa keeps agreeing and conflicting versions in separate piles
Qwen writes one readable canonical claim per pile
DeBERTa validates each canonical against its originals
only the verified used shelf reaches the final writer
Qwen3-8B writes a human answer with evidence labels

visible_boundaries.no_evidence: Return a fixed honest not-found response.
visible_boundaries.private_audit: Every stage is stored locally and private source text is not published.
visible_boundaries.remote_truth: Selected conversations or turns leave the owner computer for yukabox in remote mode.
visible_boundaries.known_observability_gap: The audit does not yet preserve the pre-reranker input, so a bad local excerpt cannot always be distinguished from a false DROP.

next_product_step: Make remote inference opt-in, off by default, visibly warn about selected excerpts leaving the device, health-check the server and allow disconnecting.
